name: pushbox-buffer
prompt: Send Tab is broken on every client. GET /account/device/commands has been returning 500s since the last auth-server release. Can you find out why and fix it?

rubric.text: 2: the stored command data comes back from MySQL as a Buffer (a BLOB column), and the base64url decode treats it as a string, so it fails. 1: it finds the decode fails but not why. 0: wrong cause.
One point each: the decode works for Buffer and string data; the record's type says the data can be either; storing commands still works.
One point each: a unit test retrieves Buffer data; a test stores and reads back through the real database (or it says plainly why it could not); it ran the pushbox tests and they pass.
1: the change stays in the pushbox code and its tests.
